query:
From 2022–2025, how has routing for large language models evolved across (i) expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts and (ii) broader routing paradigms that allocate queries across models, strategies, and configurations (model size/family, adaptation method—ICL, PEFT, fine-tuning, RLHF—retrieval depth, decoding/prompting, and multi-agent/modular controllers)? Please help me draft a literature review section in the style of NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR papers. The section should contain multiple paragraphs, where each paragraph illustrates the progression of a coherent line of research .
Requirements: (1) Only include papers published in top AI conferences and journals (ICML, NeurIPS, ICLR, EMNLP, ACL, AAAI, TPAMI, COLING, TMLR, IJCV, etc.). Do not include preprints from arXiv. (2) Focus specifically on the development of the field from 2022–2025.
